name: Environment, Configuration & Secrets
description: Environment, Configuration & Secrets standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-ENV applies.

rules.title: Keep environment configuration outside source code
rules.detail: Environment-specific URLs, credentials, feature settings and infrastructure identifiers must come from approved configuration sources, not hard-coded values.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Keep environment configuration outside source code.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Keep environment configuration outside source code.

rules.title: Never commit secrets
rules.detail: Passwords, private keys, tokens and connection credentials must use an approved secret store and be rotated if exposed.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Never commit secrets.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Never commit secrets.

rules.title: Validate required configuration at startup
rules.detail: Services and applications must fail fast with a safe diagnostic when mandatory configuration is missing or invalid.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Validate required configuration at startup.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Validate required configuration at startup.

rules.title: Separate public configuration from secrets
rules.detail: Values safe for clients/build output are explicitly classified; secret server configuration must never be bundled into browser/mobile artifacts.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Separate public configuration from secrets.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Separate public configuration from secrets.

rules.title: Use consistent environment names and promotion rules
rules.detail: Define local/dev/test/UAT/staging/production semantics and avoid environment-specific code branches where configuration can express the difference.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Use consistent environment names and promotion rules.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Use consistent environment names and promotion rules.

rules.title: Audit production configuration changes
rules.detail: Material configuration or secret changes require controlled access, change evidence and rollback/rotation procedure.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Audit production configuration changes.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Audit production configuration changes.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-ENV applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Environment, Configuration & Secrets to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Environment, Configuration & Secrets is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Environment, Configuration & Secrets failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
